newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Simsmetal falls on profit outlook.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Simsmetal falls on profit outlook.

text.p: Shares in scrap metal merchant Simsmetal Ltd fell sharply on Friday in response to the company's first quarter profit slump and its forecast of an even weaker 1996/97 second quarter.
Simsmetal shares were 14 cents lower at A$6.90 at 11.05 a.m. (0105 GMT) in a stronger overall market. They fell 10 cents on Thursday in an immediate response to the poor profit result.
"It (the share price weakness) is pretty much straightforward," said the head of an institutional dealing desk. "Earning declines hit stocks quite hard. That is a very thin stock anyway," he said.
"It was wobbly even down at A$7.04 yesterday. So it was weak yesterday and weaker today," said the broker, who asked not to be named.
Simsmetal reached a low of A$6.88 in early Friday trade, 18 cents above its 1996 low.
The company said on Thursday that its first quarter net profit fell 34 percent to A$8.28 million due to a four-year low for metal prices.
It added that trading conditions were expected to remain difficult and that earnings would be below those achieved in the first quarter. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
